name: fix_ts_lexicographic_number_sort
description: Fixes a TS function relying on default Array.sort, which sorts numbers lexicographically
prompts: ranked in ranked.ts should return the scores in ascending NUMERIC order without mutating the input array. It calls sort() with no comparator, and JavaScript's default sort converts elements to strings and orders them lexicographically - so [10, 2, 33, 4] comes back unsorted-looking instead of [2, 4, 10, 33]. Fix it with a numeric comparator, keep the copy-before-sort behavior (the caller's array must not change), and keep the function signature.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit ranked.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build ranked.ts
node behavior_test.js
